narration: For {identical_months} month the two lives ran exactly alike. In month {fork_month}, you chose {real_choice} and the ghost took {ghost_choice}. That same month, {first_bar_apart} was the first score to part. In month {layoff_month}, the month of the layoff and the month the money stood furthest apart, the ghost had {layoff_net_worth_gap}. At month {end_month} the ghost finished with {net_worth_gap}. Its days sat a shade lighter, with Life {life_gap}.
